03 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE WORK

Behind
the systems.

My interests sit at the intersection of cybersecurity, software engineering, and AI. I enjoy understanding how systems work, where they can fail, and how to make them more reliable.

Originally from India, I moved to the U.S. to study at Arizona State University. My experience spans supporting people with everyday technology, building software in industry, and testing security ideas through hands-on projects.

Outside technology, I’ve played club soccer for more than ten years and volunteered with the Paramhansa Yogananda Charitable Trust in Ahmedabad, supporting community events, education initiatives, and essential-supply distribution.
